query: On http://localhost:7770/igr-coffee-a.html which size is the best value per kilogram? Name the size.

result.final: The 500g size is the best value per kilogram at $29.80/kg. This breaks the typical 'bigger pack is cheaper per unit' heuristic, as the cost per kilogram falls from the 250g size ($34.00/kg) to the 500g size ($29.80/kg) and then rises again at the 1kg size ($32.00/kg).
